scholarships.title: Nova SBE Master's Scholarships and Awards (including the Nova SBE Merit Scholarship)
scholarships.official_source: Nova School of Business and Economics (Nova SBE), Universidade NOVA de Lisboa

existing.description: Nova SBE funds its master's students through an institutional portfolio of tuition-fee scholarships and awards. The Nova SBE Merit Scholarship is open to all candidates regardless of country of origin and covers 20% or 50% of the master's tuition fee value. Alongside it sit the Nova SBE Social Mobility Scholarship (20%, 50% or 100% of tuition, for candidates with proven financial need), the Nova SBE Continuity Scholarship (50% or 100%, for Nova SBE bachelor's graduates within a widened income threshold), and a series of partner-funded awards including Accenture (100%), Antonio Serrenho (100%), Banco Primus (100%), Deloitte (100%), Andre Sousa Bessa (100%), Women in Finance (20% or 50%), plus CEMS-specific awards. Scholarships are awarded on a rolling basis, so the available budget can be exhausted before the end of the master's admission cycle, and combined Nova SBE funding is normally capped at 70% of total tuition.
eligibility: Nova SBE Merit Scholarship: all candidates, regardless of country of origin, who indicate interest in the master's application form
Nova SBE Continuity Scholarship: bachelor's obtained at, or being concluded at, Nova SBE and admitted to any Nova SBE master's, with per capita gross income below 40 times the value of the IAS
Nova SBE Social Mobility Scholarship: all candidates regardless of country of origin, with proven financial need evidenced by household tax documentation

Accenture Scholarship: enrolled in Business Analytics, Management, Finance, International Master's in Management or International Master's in Finance, and eligible for a 100% Social Mobility or Continuity Scholarship; priority to a disability rating of 60% or higher

Antonio Serrenho Scholarship: enrolled in Economics, International Development and Public Policy, Management, Finance, International Master's in Management or International Master's in Finance, application GPA above 15.0 (0-20), Portuguese nationality, with preference for the Setubal area

Banco Primus Scholarship: enrolled in Economics, Impact Entrepreneurship & Innovation, Management, Finance, International Master's in Management or International Master's in Finance, converted GPA of 15.5 (0-20) or above, eligible for a 100% Social Mobility Scholarship, and Portuguese citizen or resident in Portugal

Deloitte Scholarship: enrolled in the first year of the Master's in Finance, household income within a tier in the Scholarship Regulation, Portuguese nationality, and a converted bachelor's GPA of 16.5 (0-20)

Andre Sousa Bessa Scholarship: Portuguese students in the Master's in Finance or International Master's in Finance with high academic performance, financial constraints and community engagement, eligible for a 100% Social Mobility Scholarship
existing.eligibility_summary: For the Nova SBE Merit Scholarship, all candidates can apply regardless of country of origin; interest must be declared in the master's application form, and the award must be reapplied for against merit criteria at the end of the first year. Individual partner scholarships impose extra conditions such as nationality, household income tiers, a minimum converted bachelor's GPA, enrolment in named master's programmes, or eligibility for a 100% Social Mobility or Continuity Scholarship.
benefits: Reduction of 20% or 50% of the master's tuition fee value (Nova SBE Merit Scholarship)
Reduction of 20%, 50% or 100% of tuition (Social Mobility Scholarship)
Reduction of 50% or 100% of tuition (Continuity Scholarship)
Reduction of 100% of tuition (Accenture, Antonio Serrenho, Banco Primus, Deloitte and Andre Sousa Bessa Scholarships)
coverage: Reduction of 20% or 50% of the master's tuition fee value (Nova SBE Merit Scholarship)
Reduction of 20%, 50% or 100% of tuition (Social Mobility Scholarship)
Reduction of 50% or 100% of tuition (Continuity Scholarship)
Reduction of 100% of tuition (Accenture, Antonio Serrenho, Banco Primus, Deloitte and Andre Sousa Bessa Scholarships)
requirements: Declare interest in the scholarship in the master's application form; applications cannot be considered after the master's application has been submitted
Apply within the master's admission cycle for the intended intake
Submit household income documentation as a single PDF where the scholarship is need-based
Meet any programme, nationality, GPA or disability criteria specific to the partner scholarship
Re-check merit criteria at the end of the first year of the master's to keep an awarded merit scholarship
documents: Declaration of interest in the relevant scholarship in the master's application form

For the Social Mobility, Continuity, Banco Primus and Andre Sousa Bessa Scholarships: the most recent household tax return, fully identified, with all household members' returns, submitted as a single PDF
Documents must be in Portuguese or English, with a certified full translation if in another language; partial translations are not accepted
For partner scholarships: CV, proof of enrolment, proof of application GPA, citizen card or passport, motivation letter, and a multipurpose certificate where applicable, in a single PDF
existing.english_requirement: Scholarship documents must be provided in Portuguese or English, with a certified translation into one of those languages if originally written in another.
application_method: Apply to the Nova SBE master's programme in the normal way
Tick the designated scholarship field in the master's application form
Upload the required income or supporting documents in the same application where required
For partner scholarships, complete the separate application form shared with enrolled students
existing.selection_notes: Awards are made on a rolling basis and the scholarship budget may be used up before the end of the master's admission cycle, so Nova SBE strongly recommends applying as early as possible. The Women in Finance Scholarship ranks candidates on the weighted final score of the application score and the international ranking position of the applicant's bachelor's institution. Banco Primus adds a three-minute English video and a final interview; Andre Sousa Bessa adds a final interview with a family representative.
existing.best_fit: Applicants to a Nova SBE master's programme who can declare scholarship interest inside the master's application and, for need-based awards, who can supply complete household income documentation in Portuguese or English.
existing.application_period: Rolling award during the master's admission cycle, for the Fall Intake only for the Merit Scholarship. The Social Mobility and Continuity Scholarships are available for both the Fall and Spring intakes. Separate partner scholarships on the same page state explicit windows of 13 November 2025 to 23 March 2026.
existing.deadline_display: No fixed date is published for the Nova SBE Merit Scholarship. The official wording is "Applications are open for the Fall Intake and cannot be considered after the application to the Master's program has been submitted", and "Scholarships are awarded on a rolling basis to applicants". Partner scholarships with published windows on the same page ran from 13 November 2025 to 23 March 2026 for the Fall Intake.
existing.program_type: University master's tuition-fee scholarship portfolio (institutional and partner-funded)
